defense_news.title: Iranian strikes damaged hundreds of US military buildings, dozens of aircraft
defense_news.summary: Iranian strikes have damaged hundreds of U.S. military and diplomatic buildings, as well as dozens of aircraft, a Pentagon watchdog said.

defense_news.title: F-35 proved combat readiness during Middle East deployments, Air Force officials say
defense_news.summary: Top Air Force officials praised the F-35's warfighting prowess during combat operations in the Middle East despite recent concerns over readiness rates.

defense_news.title: US Marine Stand-In Forces in the Pacific worry China, report details
defense_news.summary: The Marine Corps' plan to reorganize for small-unit expeditionary warfare has sparked concern among some Chinese naval officers, a recent report details.

defense_news.title: UN weighs moving Ukraine aid supplies underground after warehouse hits
